deviations.detail: Interrogation ran as 5 batched principal spawns (identity/risk; fact-profile/type; team/stack/deploy; KM/values/exclusions; floor+deck) rather than one spawn per single question. RUN-PROTOCOL explicitly allows 'a fresh principal subagent per question batch'. One-question-per-turn craft honored within each batch's framing.

Grading/review seats (cold intent reviewer, validator) were dispatched as FRESH SUBAGENTS rather than played inline by the lead. The protocol specifies single-agent simulation but requires grader outputs 'strictly from the artifact text' and author!=grader independence; fresh subagents guarantee both. Principal answers were spawned per the mandated D3 fence. The lead never read persona-card.md.

The first governance-intent.md draft mistakenly carried a PRE-FILLED Review section (predicted findings) before the cold review ran. A first cold-reviewer spawn read that contaminated synthesis. Caught and corrected: the Review section was reset to a genuine pre-review state (sizing ruled, findings pending) and a FRESH cold reviewer re-ran Phase 1 against the clean synthesis. The recorded review (10 raised / 8 survived, 4 Critical) is that clean run; the contaminated first spawn was discarded. Net effect on the judged artifact: none — the final synthesis reflects a genuine, uncontaminated cold read and its user-ruled dispositions.
